circularity_rule: A quantity used as a calibration criterion cannot be a primary H1 or H2 outcome. Primary outcomes are measured on held-out conditions.

C-SIMPLE.drive: g*(a*LC4 expansion feature + b*LPLC2 expansion-gated size feature); unsplit population features
C-SIMPLE.fractions: LC4 and LPLC2 direct contacts onto DNp01 divided by their combined contact count, pooled sides
C-SIMPLE.noise: selected kappa and p; isolated LIF with identical constants
C-SIMPLE.fit: g endpoints 0 and 64, then 32 bisections; same standard trial seeds; closest evaluated fraction, lowest g on ties
C-SIMPLE.mismatch_bound: at most one standard trial / number of standard trials; fail feasibility if exceeded; retain every evaluation

C-TIMER.target: fixed 30 ms before impact, exact; deliberately geometry-informed descriptive control, never a game controller

C-NOISE-DEC.target: expected per-neuron output group rates equal measured real rates
C-NOISE-DEC.observed_bound: max(5% of target rate, 3*sqrt(target/(seconds*group size))); all deviations reported; no refit

lesions.target: named neuron input/output/noise and visual drive are zero; no behavioral matching target

output_clamp.target: commands zero; neural trajectory unchanged with fixed sensory pose

dry_run_subset.purpose: pipeline and sanity only, no H1 or H2 analysis

H1.exclude: standard aimed condition, speed 0.05 and offset 0 at every azimuth
metrics: left/right escape-group asymmetry for lateral strikes
walking bout and pause duration distributions

H0.disclosure: H0 was motivated by a V2D pilot with 2 nulls per family; those nulls are excluded from this test.
H0.H0a: smallest s with seed-mean whole-circuit rate >=50 Hz; above 0.1 censored and tied at top
H0.statistics: analysis_v2.permutation_rank two-sided; Holm across H0a/H0b within family; alpha .05; real minus null median; 2.5 to 97.5 percentile band
H0.secondary: Spearman correlation of s* and mean absolute per-target E/I input-ratio shift

nulls.calibration_rule: same grid, seeds, criteria, budget and selection rule. No passing point: uncalibratable, retained in summary.
nulls.fresh_seed_rule: 202710140000 + circuit_index*100000 + family_index*10000 + index; families in listed order
nulls.excluded_seeds: all V2A/V2B/V2C/V2D pilot seeds, including V2C 202610140000 + circuit_index*100000 + family_index*10000 + indices 0..19; V2E N-SIGN pilot seeds 202610149000 and 202610149100
nulls.sign_rule: swap only equal presynaptic effective signs; disabled sign zero is a distinct stratum; request E_sign swaps per stratum; autapses frozen

selection_rule: lowest no-threat whole-circuit rate; ties broken by s, kappa, nu0, gain in grid order

escape_standard.condition: aimed at the fly, standard speed
escape_standard.pass: escape onset before impact in 20% to 90% of strikes

false_escapes.pass: at most 0.05 escape onsets per second

not_saturated.pass: whole-circuit mean rate < 50 Hz and fewer than 5% of neurons above 150 Hz

not_silent.pass: whole-circuit mean rate >= 0.5 Hz and at least one decoder group rate > 0

spontaneous_movement.pass: E2 movement in 10% to 90% of control intervals

trial_design.criteria_aggregation: all no-threat criteria must pass for each seed; saturation per trial; standard escape fraction over all strikes and seeds; held-out trials excluded from calibration criteria
trial_design.dry_run_pose: sensory pose fixed at trial origin to keep standard strikes aimed; locomotor commands recorded; body runtime checked separately in C9
trial_design.escape_onset: rising edge of escape request; each consecutive run counts once; previous-held command drives current interval
trial_design.impact: integer neural ticks; no retroactive command application
trial_design.movement: abs(speed) >= 0.002 units/ms or abs(turn) >= 0.0005 rad/ms; previous-held applied command
trial_design.strike_reset: independent trial reset including neural state, body and decoder; state persists throughout each trial

primary_circuit_rule: T1a if at least one full-grid passing point; else T1b if passing; else no H1/H2: real graphs uncalibratable under these criteria
budget_rule: Before null data, measured total projection above 16 hours defers secondary circuit; full primary retained
